hard_rules.prediction_edge: Must beat the relevant raw market benchmark on both Brier score and log loss in repeated non-overlapping windows.
hard_rules.information_edge: Opening-to-closing movement model must improve zero-change MSE on average and produce positive realized CLV in at least 3 of 5 evaluation seasons for at least one market side.
hard_rules.execution_edge: Any simulated profitability must remain positive after modeled edge erosion; otherwise treat the signal as non-executable even if prediction quality is good.

anti_overfitting: Do not tune thresholds on the held-out season.
Do not accept a feature because one season is strongly positive.
Do not treat closing odds as a model input for pre-closing predictions.
Discard proxy features that fail the raw-market benchmark even if they have intuitive tactical meaning.
